verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes an official GitHub repository (docusign/OpenAPI-Specifications) of OpenAPI/Swagger files. It says the files let both humans and computers discover the service's capabilities, and it uses them to generate its client SDKs via swagger-codegen. The probe 404s at developers.docusign.com/openapi.json and similar paths only show the spec is not served from the developer portal; it is still downloadable from GitHub. Missing for 10: discoverable spec at a standard well-known URL on the developer site, evidence of which APIs and spec versions are covered and kept current, and independent hands-on corroboration of using the spec.
